main.description: Keyed self. Readers believe it on repositories the account owns or is a collaborator on, and in the commits a pull of its brought into a repository when merged. An account's first push claims the address git commits as there; after that it changes only when the account says.

hashes.description: Each the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the account's DID, a newline, and the address trimmed and lowercased: salted with the DID, so the record names no address and one address hashes apart in each account that claims it.

description: The email addresses an account's commits are authored as, so pages can show those commits as the account's.
